stories.title: Meridian System Image Reference Map Generator for Tuinalogy KP Documents
stories.description: Create a Python generator that reads meridian theory from KP documents and auto-generates structured markdown tables with bilingual headers (简体中文/English/Bahasa Melayu) showing meridian names, acupoint counts, pathway descriptions, and image placeholder syntax.
acceptanceCriteria: Generator creates markdown table for each of 12 primary meridians + 8 extraordinary vessels showing: meridian name (ZH/EN/BM), starting point, ending point, acupoint count, key clinical applications, and image placeholder markdown syntax
Script generates output file: tuinalogy-services/C01/meridian-reference-map.md with properly formatted tables and bilingual terminology matching NOSS MP-031-3:2016
Validation confirms all meridian names in table match NOSS CoCU terminology with no mismatches
technicalNotes: File to create: build/tuinalogy_meridian_generator.py (function: generate_meridian_reference_table)
File to modify: tuinalogy-services/C01/KP-01.md (insert meridian reference table after introduction)
Test command: uv run python build/tuinalogy_meridian_generator.py --validate --output tuinalogy-services/C01/meridian-reference-map.md

stories.title: Tuinalogy Technique Step-by-Step Procedure Formatter for KK Documents
stories.description: Build a formatter that converts narrative technique descriptions from KP documents into numbered step-by-step procedures with anatomical landmarks, hand positioning, force guidance, timing, and safety callouts for KK (work sheet) documents.
acceptanceCriteria: Formatter converts unstructured technique text into numbered steps (1-12 per technique) with fields: step number, action (ZH), anatomical landmark, hand position, force level (轻/中/重), duration (sec), safety note
Output markdown includes safety callout box at top of each technique: [!WARNING] 禁忌: [contraindication list]
Generated KK procedures validate against NOSS CoCU work activity descriptions for C01-C05 with match percentage reported
technicalNotes: File to create: build/tuinalogy_kk_formatter.py (function: format_technique_to_procedure)
File to modify: tuinalogy-services/*/KK-*.md (apply formatter to all 7 CUs)
Test command: uv run python build/tuinalogy_kk_formatter.py tuinalogy-services/C01/KK-01.md --validate

stories.title: Acupoint Palpation Landmark Descriptor Generator for Anatomy Resources
stories.description: Create a Python tool that generates detailed anatomical palpation descriptions for 50+ key acupoints used in Tuinalogy. Outputs include skeletal landmarks, muscle/nerve references, palpation depth guidelines, and differential anatomy. Bilingual format (ZH/EN/BM).
acceptanceCriteria: Generator creates markdown file: tuinalogy-services/_assets/acupoint-landmarks-atlas.md with 50+ acupoints, each entry containing: acupoint code, Chinese/English name, anatomical landmarks (bone/muscle), palpation depth (寸/cm), neighboring structures, palpation technique tip
Each acupoint entry includes image placeholder syntax: ![Landmark](./anatomy/acupoint_code.png) ready for anatomy diagram insertion
Validation confirms all acupoint codes match NOSS CoCU standard nomenclature and no duplicate entries exist

stories.title: Tuinalogy Related Knowledge Prerequisite Mapper for CU Learning Paths
stories.description: Build a dependency mapper that identifies prerequisite knowledge chains for each CU (TCM theory → meridian system → acupoint location → technique application). Validates that every KP document addresses required prerequisites and flags missing learning objectives.
acceptanceCriteria: Mapper generates dependency graph showing: C01 prerequisites (TCM basics, yin/yang, 四诊) → C02 (meridian pathways) → C03-C05 (technique application). Outputs as markdown flowchart in tuinalogy-services/learning-paths.md
Tool scans all KP-*.md files and reports which prerequisites are covered vs. missing with file path and line reference for each gap
Generated report includes suggested learning sequence for instructors and identifies orphaned KP topics not tied to any CU learning objective

stories.title: Tuinalogy KP Document Readability Enhancer with Markdown Tables and Callouts
stories.description: Convert dense theory paragraphs in KP (knowledge/information sheet) documents into visually scannable formats using markdown tables, subheadings, concept boxes, and mnemonic callouts. Applies to TCM theory, meridian descriptions, and acupoint sections across all CUs.
acceptanceCriteria: Enhancer converts dense KP-01 (TCM theory) narrative into: definition table (concept | ZH | EN | BM), 8-principles diagram (ASCII table), 4-examination framework (flowchart)
Output markdown includes callout boxes for key terms: [!NOTE] 定义: [term definition with example]
Readability validation confirms average paragraph length reduced from 150+ words to <80 words with subheading coverage >90%
